description: Produces WAV, Ogg or Opus files (≤180 s, loops, stems) to download and embed in a game, app, presentation or video. To listen, song's share link plays it, no render. Send mtl, ref or compose; it checks the song itself. Files last 2 h; https://moosetracker.app/acceptable-use.html Schema 2a55f659.

audition.description: Hear one channel alone as a preview; try swaps its sound: {ch:3, try:"i3 \"Warm Pad\""}

compose.description: Instead of mtl: {bpm, form, chords, parts:[{id,gen}]}. describe(topic="generators")

detail.description: Adds score, per-section loudness and MIX flags with fixes

format.description: Default wav; ogg = Vorbis 44.1 kHz; opus = Ogg Opus 48 kHz

len.description: Exact seconds: a short song repeats its order (said in the result), a long one fades out; never silence

mtl.description: Song in MTL text (describe topic=mtl). Kept 2 hours as a working copy: later calls can send ref (the songId) instead.

preview.description: One section (range, default 1), ≤20 s Opus, light quota, MIX flags

ref.description: Instead of mtl: a songId from an earlier reply (kept 2 hours), a render asset id, or a share link

skip_review.description: Reason to skip a full song's deep review (else it comes first)

name: render
title: Render a song to audio
